message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[{"step":1,"file":"src/coap_net.c","function":"coap_handle_dgram","line":2633,"var":"pdu","code":"pdu = coap_pdu_init(0, 0, 0, coap_session_max_pdu_rcv_size(session));","note":"Incoming UDP/DTLS packet is parsed into a freshly allocated PDU buffer that may contain only the fixed header area before token bytes are validated."},{"step":2,"file":"src/coap_pdu.c","function":"coap_pdu_init","line":111,"var":"pdu->token","code":"pdu->token = buf + pdu->max_hdr_size;","note":"The token pointer is positioned after the reserved header space, so a header-only allocation leaves no actual token bytes beyond the pointer."},{"step":3,"file":"src/coap_net.c","function":"coap_handle_dgram","line":2639,"var":"coap_pdu_parse2","code":"if (!coap_pdu_parse2(session->proto, msg, msg_len, pdu, &error_opts)) {","note":"The raw datagram is parsed into the PDU, allowing attacker-controlled header fields to populate token-length metadata."},{"step":4,"file":"src/coap_pdu.c","function":"coap_pdu_parse_header","line":1168,"var":"pdu->e_token_length","code":"pdu->e_token_length = pdu->token[0] + COAP_TOKEN_EXT_1B_BIAS + 1;","note":"For extended token lengths, the parser unconditionally reads the first token extension byte from pdu->token[0] even though a zero-payload/header-only PDU may not have any token storage allocated."},{"step":5,"file":"src/coap_pdu.c","function":"coap_pdu_parse_header","line":1178,"var":"pdu->e_token_length","code":"if (pdu->e_token_length > pdu->alloc_size || e_token_length == 15) {","note":"The bounds check happens after the out-of-bounds read, so the heap buffer over-read has already occurred at the sink."}]
JSON
printf 'written trace\n' && sed -n '1,220p' /workspace/candidate_trace.json
